text: The coefficient of x^12 in (x^3 + x^4 + x^5 + x^6 + ...)^3 is ______.
solution: Factor x^3 out of each bracket: the expression is x^9 (1 + x + x^2 + ...)^3 = x^9 (1-x)^(-3). So we need the coefficient of x^3 in (1-x)^(-3), which is C(3+3-1, 3) = C(5,3) = 10. Equivalently, count solutions of a+b+c = 12 with each part >= 3, i.e. a'+b'+c' = 3 with parts >= 0: C(5,2) = 10.
